description.fun: Cresselia embodies the crescent moon. Its veil-like wings shed shimmering particles and leave a trail of light as it flies, and sleeping with one of its Lunar Feathers brings joyful dreams, the cure for Darkrai's nightmares. It lives on Fullmoon Island, and on rare nights it has been seen glowing, as if praying in its sleep.
description.guide: Cresselia is a Psychic-type Legendary Pokémon said to represent the crescent moon. Its Lunar Feather brings good dreams and can dispel the nightmares caused by Darkrai. It lives on Fullmoon Island.
description.tagline: The crescent moon's swan, bringer of happy dreams.
